name: browser-use
headline: Healthcare Appointment Booking: AI Automation
short_description: An AI-based system that helps manage healthcare appointments using different agents for tasks like booking, cancelling, and answering questions.
author: JHansiduYapa

sections.overview:
This multi-agent system automates healthcare appointment management by routing user requests to specialized AI agents. It uses a router agent to direct queries to booking, cancellation, or general inquiry handlers, a RAG agent to answer questions by retrieving context from PDF documents, and tool nodes for appointment operations and doctor searches. The system converts responses to speech via ElevenLabs and is built on LangGraph for extensible, modular workflow management.
Automating new appointment bookings through conversational AI
Processing appointment cancellations without manual intervention
Answering patient inquiries about hospital services and policies
Searching for available doctors and checking appointment availability
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/JHansiduYapa/Multi-Agent-System-for-Healthcare-Appointment-Booking`
sections.usage:
```
Act as a multi-agent system for healthcare appointment booking. Create three agents: a booking agent, a cancellation agent, and an information agent. The booking agent should schedule appointments for [PATIENT_NAME] at [HEALTHCARE_PROVIDER] for [DATE] at [TIME]. The cancellation agent should cancel appointments for [PATIENT_NAME] at [HEALTHCARE_PROVIDER] for [DATE] at [TIME]. The information agent should answer questions about appointment policies, wait times, and provider availability at [HEALTHCARE_PROVIDER]. Ensure all agents communicate with each other to avoid scheduling conflicts and provide accurate information.
```
